why_value_exists: The completed GWTC-5.0 result is explicitly limited to one O4b release, one 22-event frame and one triad, so an independent O4a cohort directly tests the main unresolved portability boundary.
GWTC-4.1 contains 44 value-blind events with exact common-5 availability for IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor, SEOBNRv5PHM and NRSur7dq4, sufficient for a fixed all-event test without event replacement.
The predictor, posterior response, aggregation rule, direction, alpha and Monte Carlo procedure can be transported unchanged; only the public release and the unavailable middle model change.
Candidate numeric summary values and candidate posterior elements remain unaccessed, allowing the target contract to be frozen before its outcomes are seen.
novelty_and_added_value: A target-value-blind cross-release conceptual transport test on 44 disjoint O4a events. It evaluates whether the cheap summary/full-posterior rank association survives both a new observing cohort and substitution of SEOBNRv5PHM for the unavailable IMRPhenomXPNR.

substituted_model.reason: IMRPhenomXPNR is not present in the GWTC-4.1 PE release.

not_scientific_value: It is not an independent physical truth test because predictor and response still derive from the same release products.
It is not a strict replication because one model differs and the releases/candidate populations differ.
It cannot support model superiority, causal waveform-systematic attribution, GR/Kerr/no-hair or new-physics claims.
